user.title: eVodnik local proxy
user.description: Configure the local listener and vendor endpoint. The vendor and device can be offline. MQTT publication uses your existing Home Assistant MQTT integration.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure eVodnik
reconfigure.description: Saving changes restarts the proxy. The device must reconnect.

error.listener_in_use: Cannot bind this listener. Check the address, port, and other entries.
error.mqtt_prefix_in_use: Another eVodnik entry uses this MQTT prefix.
error.proxy_loop: The target must not point back to this listener.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Configuration updated. The proxy will restart.

init.title: Set water meter reading
init.description: Enter the current water meter reading in whole liters, or zero to count usage from now. The device must be connected. Future consumption is added automatically. This changes only the local reading and does not restart the proxy or write to the device.

error.invalid_reading: Enter a nonnegative whole number of liters.
error.counter_unavailable: Cannot read a fresh device counter. Check the device connection and try again.

abort.integration_unavailable: The integration must be running to set the water meter reading.
